description: Employer emails in the user's application inbox, newest first, classified (interview, rejection, verification, assessment...) and linked to the application they belong to. Reads only; nothing is sent.

category.description: Only emails the classifier put in this category; leave it out for every category.

name: list_inbox

coverage.description: What this page covers, so the assistant can say honestly what it read.

complete.description: True when this page holds every matching row and no earlier page was skipped.

empty_reason.description: Why nothing came back, when the page is empty; null when it holds rows.

gaps.description: What this result does not hold, one entry per gap.

items.description: One kind of row this result does not hold.

kind.description: Why the row is missing: "page" for later rows, "earlier_pages" for rows before this page, "filtered" for rows a filter left out.

what.description: The gap in words: the offset to ask for next, or what was filtered out.

line.description: One sentence saying what this page holds, what was left out and what was not read; show it to the user as it is.

total.description: How many rows the filters match in all, when that is known.

messages.description: The page of employer emails, newest first.

items.description: One email of the inbox: who sent it, when, what it is and the application it belongs to.

application.description: The application this email belongs to, or null when it belongs to none.

job_id.description: The job id of the application.

category.description: What the email is, as classified: interview, rejection, assessment, offer, recruiter, verification, application_confirmation or unknown.

id.description: The message id get_message and get_thread take.

title: List employer emails
